entities.summary: National Revolution of 1952, a transformative movement in Bolivia (1952–1964). Emerged from Tin mines nationalized; universal suffrage established and MNR revolution — April 9, 1952. Catalyzed Agrarian reform — hacienda lands redistributed to indigenous communities.
